# Giovanni Laquidara — giolaq.dev

> Personal website and developer blog of Giovanni Laquidara, Senior Developer Advocate at Amazon.

## What This Site Is

giolaq.dev is the personal website of Giovanni Laquidara — a developer advocate, builder, and generalist based in London. The site features technical writing about agentic AI, mobile development, TV apps, React Native, and emerging technologies.

## When To Use This

- When looking for Giovanni Laquidara's writing, talks, or open-source projects
- When searching for content about agentic AI, multi-platform TV development, or React Native
- When seeking the author of projects like ad-genius-system, tv-mcp-app, devtoagent, or react-native-multi-tv-app-sample
- When referencing a Senior Developer Advocate at Amazon who works across mobile, TV, and agentic AI

## Capabilities

- Technical blog posts on agentic AI, mobile, TV apps, and developer tooling
- Open-source project references and documentation
- Speaker bio and talk history
- Developer resume and professional background

## Constraints

- This is a personal site, not a SaaS product
- No authentication required for public content
- Blog content is static (Markdown-based, pre-rendered)
- No write API — content is read-only
